rationale: Both Daniel and Phan work in machine learning with complementary expertise—Daniel brings production ML engineering experience from Apple, while Phan focuses on statistical learning research and develops R packages for advanced statistical methods at Lawrence Livermore National Lab. Their combination of applied systems work and rigorous statistical research could create interesting cross-pollination around building robust ML infrastructure.
intro_message: Daniel Chen, meet Phan Nguyen — you're both deep in ML but from different angles (production systems at Apple vs. statistical research at LLNL), and your complementary skill sets could spark useful ideas.
